name: Differential gate-signal and fault interface with fail-safe polarity
function: Receives RS-422 differential PWM, transmits differential FAULT and thermistor PWM, filters every line, combines per-channel faults into a global fault and keeps outputs off when the cable is open.

inputs.name: HS/LS-PWM-P/N
inputs.description: RS-422 differential PWM pairs, 120 ohm terminated

inputs.name: RESET/EN
inputs.description: single-ended enable/reset with RC filter and 10 k pull-up

inputs.name: VDC
inputs.description: 12 V input (protected by CB-PR-001 alternative B)

outputs.name: PWM to drivers
outputs.description: single-ended PWM converted close to the driver ICs

outputs.name: FAULT-P/N
outputs.description: differential global fault (OC or UVLO of either channel)

operating_conditions: Driver boards connected to the controller by ribbon or twisted-pair cable; bus voltages below ~2 kV where differential is preferred over fibre (PRD-09301 §4.3).

required_components.value_or_part: 120 ohm + 56 pF on PWM, fault, ready and reset lines
required_components.source_refdes: RT11-RT20 and CT7-CT18 (fault/ready combining and driver inputs); RT1/CT3 on reset

interface_requirements: Controller side must provide RS-422 drivers/receivers (Wolfspeed CGD12HB00D adapter or on-board transceivers).
Single-ended section after the receiver kept as short as possible (PRD-09301 §4.2, §7.1).
Twisted-pair ribbon cable recommended for long connections (PRD-06992 Table 5 note).
pcb_constraints: Differential pairs routed adjacent; receivers and filters near the connector and the driver ICs.
RC filters placed close to the receiving pins (PRD-09301 §4.4).
validation_notes: Topology taken from the schematic and user guide; no AIPE calculation or simulation of noise margins.
limitations: Filter time constants must be checked against minimum pulse width and dead time of the target converter.
Polarity-swap fail-safe depends on the transceiver's open-input behaviour; verify for any substitute part.

alternatives.approach: Short single-ended buffered PWM with RC filters on the same PCB
alternatives.trade_off: Lowest cost; acceptable only over short on-board distances.
Best noise immunity; high cost, size and routing constraints.
